title: A Homogeneous Tensor Framework for High-Order Trust-Region and Spherical Polynomial Optimization
summary: High-order methods can improve worst-case evaluation complexity, but for orders $p\geq3$ their Taylor subproblems are nonconvex polynomial optimization problems and are generally difficult to solve. We develop a radius-controlled boundary approach based on homogeneous tensor representations. By augmenting the step with a constant coordinate, any $p$th-order Taylor polynomial can be represented exactly as an order-$p$ homogeneous tensor form; at a prescribed radius, the boundary model is a spherical polynomial optimization problem.
